facts.label: Silence (Shadow)
facts.value: Silence has 1 rank and sits on row 5, column 1 of the Shadow tree. In use: 225 Mana, 20 yd range, Instant, 45 sec cooldown.

facts.label: Silence rank 1 of 1
facts.value: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

facts.label: Devouring Contagion (Shadow)
facts.value: Devouring Contagion has 2 ranks and sits on row 5, column 3 of the Shadow tree.

facts.label: Devouring Contagion rank 1 of 2
facts.value: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 25%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to 2 nearby enemies within 5 yds for the remaining duration.

facts.label: Devouring Contagion rank 2 of 2
facts.value: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to 2 nearby enemies within 10 yds for the remaining duration.

facts.label: Early Demise rank 2 of 2

facts.label: Shadowform (Shadow)
facts.value: Shadowform has 1 rank and sits on row 7, column 2 of the Shadow tree. It requires Vampiric Embrace. In use: 40% of base mana, Instant, 1.5 sec cooldown.

facts.label: Shadowform rank 1 of 1
facts.value: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.
